title: Promotion
body:
Syntax: ask <kage> about promotion

Description: Student is the automatic starting designation, not an obtainable rank. Genin is the first rank a player can earn, by passing Iruka's Genin Exam. Progression: Student -> Genin -> Chunin -> Special Jonin -> Jonin -> Elite Jonin -> Village Elder -> Kage. Every character starts as a Student, with full access to combat and missions from the very first moment. There is no separate Academy exam.

Student -> Genin requires level 10 and all five required basic techniques at 100%: Shadow Shuriken Technique, Dynamic Entry, Demonic Illusion: Hell Viewing Technique, Throw Shuriken, and Strong Fist Style. Then find Iruka (mob VNUM 11) and 'say Start Genin exam'. His written Genin Exam asks 10 random Naruto anime questions from a pool of 20 and randomly positions four answer choices per question. You need 10 correct answers out of 10 to graduate. See 'help genin exam'.

Genin -> Chunin is earned by passing the Chunin Exam ('help exam') at level 15, not by asking the Kage.

Rank level caps: Student 10, Genin 15, Chunin 80, Special Jonin 135, Jonin 200, Elite Jonin 250, Village Elder 250, Kage 250.

Special Jonin, Jonin and Elite Jonin promotions currently use your village Kage's chamber and check the following level and mission requirements:

  Special Jonin: level 80, 50 completed missions
  Jonin: level 135, 100 completed missions
  Elite Jonin: level 200, 500 completed missions

Village Elder has no automatic promotion or exam. An administrator can confer this rank with 'mset <player> rank village elder'. Village Elder and Elite Jonin both cap at level 250.

Kage itself is never earned through a level/mission check -- it's appointed directly by staff (only one Kage per village at a time), and can also never be granted through a mob program's 'set_rank' action, specifically to protect that one-per-village rule.

Every rank also carries its own headband, with a progressively larger Armor Class bonus -- promotion swaps it automatically, whichever of the paths above actually granted it.

Every real rank change in the game -- Student -> Genin via Iruka's exam, Genin -> Chunin via the exam, or any Kage-granted promotion -- announces itself to EVERY connected player, not just the one being promoted: "[Name] has been promoted to [Rank]!"

Date: 2026-09-02

One-time legacy exception: Existing characters whose saved level already EXCEEDED a rank cap before rank caps were introduced are promoted automatically to the first ordinary rank whose cap permits their current level. This applies once when their saved character is next loaded, without replaying earlier exams or mission requirements. Existing level/XP/mastery is preserved, and earned headbands are updated. Players exactly at their caps still require their normal exam or Kage promotion. New characters never skip exams; Village Elder and Kage remain staff-appointed.
